review_comment: The code implements a direct boundary check to prevent path traversal. The vulnerability was addressed by ensuring that resolved paths remain within the specified root directory. The patch correctly adds validation to prevent attackers from using '../' sequences to escape the intended directory scope.

The code resolves and normalizes the root path but does not properly validate that it remains within restricted boundaries. An attacker can manipulate the rootPath parameter to bypass the containment check, allowing path traversal outside the intended directory. Add canonical path resolution and proper validation of the normalized root path before performing the containment check.
